integrity: Two complete cycle generators and two independent palindromic-factor algorithms agree for all 2048 cycles; exact CSV tables and executable verification are included. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Exact binary order-five classification only; circular factors are distinct words of lengths one through 32; no all-order extension is claimed. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed earlier enumerations.
title: Circular palindromic-factor complexity of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
